title: Scout Runtime Engine Result
description: Defines the universal invocation response envelope returned by every Scout Runtime Engine. An Engine Result reports one Engine invocation; it is distinct from an Execution Result Runtime Object.

state_transition.description: Structured State Transition proposal, transition reference, or null. Engine Invocation Status does not commit Runtime State; only the Runtime Orchestrator validates and commits transitions under state_model.md.

evidence_profile.description: Optional compatibility discriminator. Omission preserves the Alpha Engine Result contract; runtime_execution_evidence_v1 selects the canonical Runtime Execution Evidence profile.

runtime_execution_evidence.description: Canonical structured execution evidence for the invocation. Required when evidence_profile is runtime_execution_evidence_v1 and for every dynamic-target transition proposal.

engine_result_status.description: Final return disposition of one Engine invocation. All values are final for invocation_id; workflow resumability is governed separately. This enum is not Runtime State. The rejected values ready, running, success, and timed_out are invalid.

state_transition_reference.description: Reference to an existing State Transition proposal or record governed by state_model.md.

state_transition_proposal.description: Engine proposal for a State Model-authorised transition. Legacy Alpha proposals remain valid; canonical evidence proposals also carry mechanism, target, Decision, governance reference, and origin evidence. This object never represents a committed Runtime State change.

decision_reference.description: Reference to the authoritative structured Decision; this does not redefine the Decision Model.

transition_mechanism.description: Transition-selection mechanism registered by state_model.md. static denotes a literal allowed_to_states edge; all other values are governed dynamic-target mechanisms.

dynamic_target.description: Typed target selected under the State Model dynamic_target_model. The field name and target state must match the selected transition mechanism registry entry.

runtime_evidence_reference.description: Reference to a Runtime Object that supplies transition or execution evidence. object_type must resolve in the canonical Runtime Object Registry.

origin_context.description: Preserved context identifying the lifecycle origin from which a governed detour, retry, recovery, rollback, or revision was entered.

canonical_state_transition_proposal.description: Complete Runtime State transition evidence profile. Dynamic-target semantics remain normatively owned by state_model.md.

invocation_identity.description: Identity of the invocation whose execution evidence this Engine Result records.

decision_evidence.description: Evidence linkage to the canonical Decision Model. This section references a Decision and does not duplicate Decision semantics.

runtime_state_transition_evidence.description: State Transition proposal evidence governed by state_model.md. The Runtime Orchestrator alone validates and commits or rejects the proposal.

runtime_events_evidence.description: Runtime Events emitted or referenced as evidence for this invocation.

evidence_collection.description: Runtime Object references collected as execution, governance, approval, policy, checkpoint, or recovery evidence.

validation_results.description: Structured validation records for the result envelope and its cross-object governance evidence.

runtime_execution_evidence.description: Canonical Runtime Execution Evidence assembled for one Engine invocation.

decision_ref.summary: The retrieved package satisfies the required knowledge scope.

confidence.basis: Required authoritative sources were retrieved and validated.
